name: Dunsmuir

description.title: Dunsmuir™ - High-Yield Fusarium Resistant Short Day
paragraphs: Dunsmuir™ is California Berry Cultivars' newest short-day release, combining class-leading yield with strong Fusarium resistance confirmed in advanced greenhouse trials. In 2026 Oxnard trials it outperformed Adelanto™ and Belvedere™ by 22% on yield, with better appearance scores and larger fruit.

Across multi-year Oxnard trials (2021–2025), Dunsmuir™ led the field at 1,693 g/plant with 36.6 gram average fruit size, a 3.79 appearance score, and firmness of 1.19 lb/in² — squarely in the normal short-day range for excellent handling and shelf life.

Commercial performance backs up the trial data: at Petit Ranch in Oxnard, Dunsmuir™ delivered 7,450 trays per acre across the 2025–26 season, with 553 trays picked before February 1 — a strong early-production indicator when seasonal prices peak.
Dunsmuir™ is a licensed-access variety, available in limited quantities from CBC in fall 2026 and from California nurseries in fall 2027. Contact CBC early to secure your allocation.
